description: Why does space smell like burnt popcorn? 🌌🍿 Whenever astronauts return from a spacewalk and take off their helmets, they notice a distinct smoky, metallic aroma. NASA scientists found this scent comes from polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons—high-energy molecules produced by dying stars floating across the void. When astronauts repressurize their airlocks, these cosmic particles react with oxygen, creating the smell of a celestial barbecue. Subscribe for more incredible universe secrets! Sources: True Blood season 4, Among Us (TV series), The Dark Knight
